changelog:
✨ New Features
• Apply offline SponsorBlock segments to playlist downloads
• Show Morphe messages in snackbar instead of a toast
• Add Translate posts patch
• Highlight new in-app settings
• Add offline sponsorblock segment support for in-app downloads
• Theme: Add "Glow Morphe" experimental splash screen type
• Minimal miniplayer: Swipe the bar up to move it to the top of the screen instead of expanding the player
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide 'Unavailable videos are hidden' banner" setting
• Hidden a new type of community post
• Custom branding: Add experimental YouTube launcher icons
• Theme: Add experimental YT splash screen animation
• Validate custom header and icon folders when the option is set
• Redirect Watch later saves to a chosen playlist
• Downloads: Add download item to the Shorts menu
• Add Niconico-style live/replay comments
• Downloads: Add playlist downloads for accounts without Premium
• Channel search: Search the posts of the channel
• Playback speed: Add playback speed to the Shorts player menu
• Add Download post images patch
• Show a warning when changing 'Navigation bar style' or turning on 'Enable tablet layout in player'
• Media notification controls: Add options to seek with Previous & Next buttons
• Add to queue: Add "Native queue" setting
• Downloads: Add "Quick download on tap" setting
• Navigation bar: Add "Navigation bar style" setting
• Add Search comments patch
• Navigation bar: Add "Disable toolbar navigation tabs" setting

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio and thumbnail downloader with Save to device
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Hide layout components: Community posts are shown below a video opened from the search results, a channel or a playlist
• Navigation bar: Black band below pages and the Shorts player when the window is not drawn behind the system navigation buttons
• Feed video actions: Watch later button is shown above the video of posts, and is missing after the app language is changed
• Return YouTube Dislike: Feed thumbnail like count blinks, moves, and is missing after returning to the feed
• Captions: Stabilize automatic captions and restore translation languages
• Navigation bar: Navigation bar transluency not working
• Download post images: Match posts with texts of many lines or a single emoji
• Video quality: Extend the background resume fix of regular videos to Shorts
• Feed thumbnail badges are shown on the page header of a channel that is live
• Feed card layout: Movies converted to cards are not hidden when "Hide movies section" is enabled
• Hide layout components: "Visit the community" entry point is not hidden in the comments of a video opened from a playlist
• Ambient mode: Ambient mode is replaced by a black background with the new watch page experiment
• Feed view count: View count badge of a card that enters from the bottom loads only when its title row is shown
• Video quality: Regular video returns to the default quality when it resumes from the background
• Video quality: Buffered video is cleared with the placeholder playback times of live streams after selecting a quality
• Video quality: Short loop restarts with the previous quality when the quality is selected in its first segment
• Fix TalkBack not reading captions
• Video quality: Quality selected for a regular video is lost when the video reloads
• Video quality: Short plays the previous quality segments again when it loops
• Prevent TalkBack crashes caused by Litho hover recursion
• Ambient mode: Bypass Ambient mode restrictions does not work with 21.43
• Watch history search bar from getting hidden when selected
• Feed thumbnail badges disappear while scrolling, are missing on cards with replaced titles and are shown on live videos
• Video quality: Video restarts or plays faster after selecting a quality
• Theme: Glow startup animation does not extend to fullscreen
• Restore TalkBack access to Shorts comments and descriptions
• Hide status bar: Top bars are covered by a second status bar when the app is kept out of the camera cutout
• Video quality: Selected quality is not applied to the already buffered video
• Ask flyout menu: Ask chat window can be hidden by onscreen keyboard
• Spoof video streams: Patch can be included for root installs
• Feed video actions: Watch later button is missing after scrolling up
• Remove legacy litho buffer filtering code required for app versions less than 20.22, change legacy support to 20.26.46
• Channel page community posts do not load when feed "Hide community posts" is enabled
• Feed view count: View count badge covers the duration in right to left languages
• Feed video actions: Watch later button opens the channel in right to left languages
• Watch page feed lags when scrolling
• Feed thumbnail badges are missing after scrolling up, show a loading spinner until they are loaded
• Downloads: Downloaded videos that work at first may not work later
• Return YouTube Dislike: Feed thumbnail like count is not shown with the Classic feed card layout
• Channel whitelists: Flyout menu opens with a delay while the channel is fetched
• Litho filter: Crash when scrolling a list after a filtered element is removed
• Playback speed: Use the bold icon for the Shorts player menu item
• Premium-style queue: Fix missing titles and stale now playing row
• Premium-style queue: Play the queue when the player Next button is pressed
• Player icon style: Add Ionicons picture in picture button icon
• Add to queue: Fix native queue on experimental versions
• Litho filter: Filtered elements leave empty cells in the related videos grid of the tablet layout
• Miniplayer: Related videos lists show a black frame after exiting fullscreen and scroll down
• Add to queue: Native queue index errors crash before Android 13
• Add to queue: Feed below the player stutters while scrolling
• Minimal miniplayer: Video title and channel are missing after going back from the Shorts player
• Video quality: Shorts quality selected in the menu is not kept and is used for the next Shorts
• Disable playlist autoplay: fix looping the current video
• Captions: Old caption stays on screen after SponsorBlock skips
• Force fullscreen landscape: Screen rotates before the fullscreen gesture completes
• Search comments: Search button is not shown in the Shorts comments and is shown in other panels
• Litho filter: Filtered elements leave empty cells in the tablet layout grids
• Video quality: Shorts quality menu sets another quality than the one selected
• Minimal miniplayer: Bar is partly covered by the keyboard with the default navigation bar style
• Hide layout components: Fix actions blocked by Hide Snackbar
• Playback speed: Channel speed whitelist is not applied to preloaded Shorts
• Captions: Captions not shown in picture-in-picture on 21.16 - 21.28
• Temporarily change expired PoToken check to log only instead of a user dialog
• Theme: Custom background colors are not applied with 21.43
• Miniplayer: Minimal miniplayer is covered by the keyboard before 21.29
• Feed card layout: Shorts shelves change width and corners when only a last row with one Short is in the list
• Ambient mode: Ambient mode is not disabled with 21.43
• Miniplayer: "Disable resuming miniplayer" may not work with latest experimental app target
• Fingerprints are not found on some targets between 21.04 and 21.35
• Hide status bar: Status bar scroll color and translucent navigation bar do not follow the hidden status bar before the edge to edge flag is read
• 21.43 navigation tabs cannot be hidden
• Disable continue watching prompt: Prompt can still appear during playback
• Feed card layout: Videos of the horizontal shelves are cut by the left edge of the card
• Hide status bar: Status bar covers the top bar or leaves an empty bar above it
• Feed card layout: Horizontal shelves lose the card background when their header is scrolled out of the list
• Navigation bar: Empty band below the reply bar of the comment replies
• Navigation bar: No connection and back online bars are covered by the system navigation buttons
• Navigation bar: System navigation buttons cannot be seen in the Shorts player with the light theme
• Shorts autoplay: Overlay is out of place when going back to a Short that advanced with the comments open
• Playback speed: Channel speed whitelist does not work for Shorts
• Navigation buttons: Create button is not hidden with the new navigation bar layout
• Morphe flyout menu items are missing in the new popup menu
• Morphe flyout menu items are missing on tablets
• Hide status bar: Video player is moved below the display cutout in portrait
• Navigation bar: Translucent navigation bar is not shown without the edge to edge layout
• Miniplayer covered by the keyboard and empty band above the navigation bar

🔧 Improvements
• Treat breaking changes as major releases
• Patches now use Morphe Patcher 2.0.0
• Theme: Patches now use Morphe Patcher 2.0.0
